newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania launches two T-bill issues next month.
newsitem.headline: Romania launches two T-bill issues next month.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Thursday it would launch two rollover treasury bill issues totalling 1.3 trillion lei next month to finance the budget deficit and cover maturing papers.

The 91-day bills are offered with a coupon giving an annual yield equal to the three-month Bucharest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) set five working days ahead of the public subscription sessions, scheduled for April 4 and April 10.
The bills will be placed by the central bank (BNR) and can be bought by commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients.
Three-month BUBOR was 189.13 percent on Wednesday.

In recent months, the Finance Ministry had issued only floating rate bills with annual yield calculated at the average of the BNR's auctioned credit rates during their life period. Last week that rate was 220.02 percent.
